intro_text: Use this form to apply for a subsidy from the Bildungs- und Teilhabepaket (education and participation package) covering your child's membership fee at TSV 1862 Friedberg. The application is filled in automatically and sent to the responsible authority. You will need your current benefits notice.
leistung_asylblg: Benefits under the Asylum Seekers Benefits Act (AsylbLG)
step3_hint: You can find these details on your membership confirmation, or ask the club office.
field_faellig_am_hint: e.g. "1st of the month" or a specific date
consent_text: Your details will be processed and stored to handle your subsidy application at TSV 1862 Friedberg and to forward it to the responsible authority. See our privacy notice for more information.
consent_checkbox: I have read the privacy notice and consent to the processing of my details.
submit_success_text: Thank you. We will check your details and contact you if we have any questions.
